description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows a catalogue containing at least one product whose name includes "hammer" and at least one product whose name does not include "hammer".
steps: Note the full list of products currently displayed.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names contain "hammer" are listed; products not matching the term are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and no product name contains the string "zzzqqq".
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is displayed (exact text not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive (uppercase term)
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and the catalogue contains a product whose name is stored as "Hammer" (lowercase/mixed case in the stored name).
cases.expected: The product "Hammer" is listed; results are the same as for the lowercase term, showing the search ignores case.

cases.title: Search matches a partial product name
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and the catalogue contains a product named "Claw Hammer" and at least one product whose name does not contain "amm".
cases.expected: "Claw Hammer" is listed because the term matches part of the product name; non-matching products are not listed.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open with a catalogue of several products; a search for "hammer" has been run in this session and the list is currently filtered.
steps: Confirm the list currently shows only the filtered results.
Clear the text from the search field.
cases.expected: The full product list is displayed again, as before the search.

cases.title: Clearing the search after a no-match term restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open, the catalogue has several products, and no product name contains "zzzqqq".
steps: Enter "zzzqqq" in the search field and run the search.
Clear the text from the search field.
cases.expected: After clearing, the empty state message is gone and the full product list is displayed again.
